title: system
description: System integration: disks shown in metrics, UI language, update checks, idle/lock/sleep commands, OCR languages, pomodoro timer and clipboard storage.

disks.title: Monitored Disks
disks.description: Mount points shown in the system metrics.

x-settings.label: system.resources.disks_title
x-settings.keywords: disks mount points storage metrics usage home root

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the whole shell. Auto follows your system locale.

x-settings.label: settings.system.language
x-settings.keywords: language locale translation i18n english spanish russian auto

updateServiceEnabled.title: Update Service
updateServiceEnabled.description: Look for new releases in the background (about once an hour) and notify you.

x-settings.label: shell.system.update_service
x-settings.keywords: updates check background notify new version

idle.title: Idle
idle.description: Idle handling (hypridle-like): lock/sleep commands and timed listeners.

lock_cmd.title: Lock Command
lock_cmd.description: Runs when the session locks (loginctl lock-session, idle listeners).

before_sleep_cmd.title: Before Sleep
before_sleep_cmd.description: Runs right before the computer suspends, usually to lock the screen.

x-settings.label: settings.system.before_sleep
x-settings.keywords: suspend sleep before lock command power

after_sleep_cmd.title: After Sleep
after_sleep_cmd.description: Runs when the computer wakes up, e.g. to turn the screens back on.

x-settings.label: settings.system.after_sleep
x-settings.keywords: resume wake after sleep command power screen on

listeners.title: Listeners
listeners.description: Commands run after a period without input, in order: dim, lock, screen off, suspend. On resume runs when you come back.

x-settings.label: idle.listeners
x-settings.keywords: idle listener timeout screen off dim brightness lock suspend sleep hypridle
